title: U.S. House · North Carolina's 10th District
area: Central and western North Carolina, including all of Catawba, Iredell, Lincoln, and Yadkin counties and most of Forsyth County, including much of Winston-Salem.

context.text: Incumbent Pat Harrigan defeated a single Republican primary challenger. Ashley Bell won a six-way Democratic primary with 47.3% of the vote.

summary.text: Pat Harrigan is the Republican incumbent for North Carolina's 10th Congressional District, a former Army Green Beret and firearms-industry business owner first elected to Congress in 2024.

background.text: Born in San Diego, California, in 1987; earned a degree in nuclear engineering from the United States Military Academy at West Point in 2009.
Served in the U.S. Army as a Green Beret from 2009 to 2014.

Career experience includes co-owning firearms-industry companies ZRODelta, UnBrandedAR, and US Optics, which he says started as a business from his home in 2015 while still on active duty and now operates from a 120,000-square-foot facility employing more than 50 people.

Serves on the House Committee on Science, Space, and Technology (Energy Subcommittee; Investigations and Oversight Subcommittee) and the House Committee on Armed Services (Intelligence and Special Operations Subcommittee; Military Personnel Subcommittee; Readiness Subcommittee) for the 2025-2026 Congress.

priorities.text: In his 2022 campaign survey, said he was focused on curbing inflation, cutting spending, and pursuing an all-of-the-above domestic energy strategy including oil exploration, pipelines, fracking, nuclear, solar, wind, and coal.
priorities.quote: I'm passionate about ending inflation and getting our economy back on track. That includes an aggressive approach to an all-of-the-above energy strategy that makes America energy independent.

priorities.text: In the same survey, said he was passionate about securing the border, addressing illegal immigration, protecting the Second Amendment, and election integrity.
priorities.quote: I'm also passionate about securing the border, dealing with our illegal immigration problem, protecting the 2nd Amendment, and election integrity.

positions.summary: In an April 2025 statement on the House vote, said the SAVE Act, which requires proof of citizenship to register to vote, keeps elections limited to citizens.
positions.quote: Our elections are for American citizens, and the SAVE Act makes sure it stays that way

positions.summary: In 2026 statements on Iran war powers resolutions, said the administration had complied with the War Powers Resolution and that he opposed forcing a withdrawal, while also calling for stronger congressional engagement and saying his vote was not an endorsement of continued action without congressional involvement.
positions.quote: It is not a blank check, and it is not an endorsement of continued action without congressional involvement.

record.text: Assigned to the House Committee on Science, Space, and Technology and the House Committee on Armed Services for the 2025-2026 Congress.

candidates.name: Ashley Bell
candidates.ballotNote: Won the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary with 47.3% of the vote over five challengers.

summary.text: Ashley Bell is the Democratic nominee for North Carolina's 10th Congressional District, a physician assistant and educator running on lowering health care and housing costs.

background.text: Born in Tyler, Texas; graduated from Henderson High School.

Earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Houston (2003), a graduate degree from the Wake Forest University School of Medicine (2011), and a graduate degree from the University of Lynchburg (2019).

Career experience includes working as a physician assistant and educator; affiliated with the American Academy of Physician Associates, the Physician Assistant Education Association, the American Association of University Professors, and Democratic Women of North Carolina.

priorities.text: Says the cost of health care, rent, and housing has become unaffordable while billionaires prosper, and wants to outlaw prior authorization requirements by insurers.
priorities.quote: Everything is too expensive... People can't afford rent, or to buy homes... Prior authorization MUST be outlawed.

priorities.text: Lists saving democracy, affordability, Medicare for All, and public education funding among her policy priorities.
priorities.quote: Saving Democracy, Affordability, Medicare for All, Public Education funding and access, Affordable Higher Education, Disability Rights, Women's Rights, Human Rights

positions.summary: Supports Medicare for All and outlawing insurer prior-authorization requirements, drawing on her experience as a physician assistant treating patients who can't afford medication or mental health care.
positions.quote: Medicare For All. This is the goal.

positions.summary: Her campaign site calls for codifying a woman's right to choose and opposes abortion restrictions and bans.
positions.quote: Codify a woman's right to choose.

positions.summary: Her campaign site calls for a $17 per hour national minimum wage with cost-of-living adjustments.
positions.quote: $17/hour National Minimum Wage with cost of living scale adjustments

positions.summary: Her campaign site calls for abolishing ICE and replacing it with a new immigration enforcement system, while saying the country still needs immigration enforcement and reform.
positions.quote: Not only should we abolish ICE, but we should hold those who beat, murdered and enabled these crimes accountable.

positions.summary: Her campaign site lists gun reform among the additional policies she supports while also saying she supports the Second Amendment.
positions.quote: Common sense gun reform. We support the 2nd amendment, but we don't support gun violence.

positions.summary: Her campaign site lists the Green New Deal, including a transition to clean, renewable energy, among her policies.
positions.quote: Green New Deal. Transition to clean, renewable energy; public transit expansion, increase jobs in clean energy and manufacturing, decreases pollution.

positions.summary: Her campaign site calls for repealing legislation such as the SAVE Act, which she says imposes unfair requirements on voters.
positions.quote: Recent legislation (like the SAVE Act) imposes unfair and unnecessary requirements that disproportionately impact women.

positions.summary: Her campaign site lists recognizing Palestinian statehood and stopping funding for Israel's military actions among her policies.
positions.quote: Recognize Palestinian Statehood and stop funding Israel's attacks.

positions.summary: Her campaign site says that taxing billionaires appropriately, along with ending spending on ICE, would pay for Medicare for All.
positions.quote: If we tax billionaires appropriately and stop spending billions on a paramilitary domestic terrorism force called ICE, we can afford it easily.

summary.text: Steven Feldman is the Libertarian Party candidate for North Carolina's 10th Congressional District.
